### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A19, A20, A25, A26 and A27 each ran in roughly 18–25 in 100 traces, about a third of the way into the case (mean position about 0.34–0.37), and 97–100 in 100 of their observed outgoing transitions went to A28; A47 in turn sent about 90 in 100 of its transitions to these five (16–21 in 100 each) and reached A28 only two steps later. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR008, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, LAG005]
- In the earlier window, A29 — present in every trace at about position 0.60 — led to A30 in about 98–99 in 100 transitions and A30 led to A34 in about 97 in 100; A29→A30 and A30→A34 were one step apart in about 98–99 in 100 cases, and A29→A34 two steps in about 97 in 100. [DIR006, DIR007, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003]
- In the later window, the same five activities still occur at similar frequencies (about 17–24 in 100 traces) but much later (mean position about 0.58–0.63), and their outgoing transitions now go almost entirely to A30 and A34 (together about 94–96 in 100), with only about 0–4 in 100 still leading to A28. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005]
- In the later window, A47 leads almost always straight to A28 (about 91 in 100 of its transitions, one step apart in about 91 in 100 cases), whereas before it reached A28 two steps later through one of the five. [DIR008, LAG005]
- In the later window, A29's transitions to A30 drop from about 98–99 to about 50 in 100, with the five activities now taking about 47 in 100 of A29's outgoing transitions; likewise A30→A34 drops to about 49 in 100, with the five taking about 50 in 100. [DIR006, DIR007]
- Matching this, A29→A30 and A30→A34 are now two steps apart in about 48–50 in 100 cases (one step in about 49–51), and A29→A34 is three steps in about 94 in 100 where it was two steps in about 97. [LAG001, LAG002, LAG003]
- The order between each of A19, A20, A25, A27 and the anchors A28/A29 reversed: earlier the block member always came first when the pair co-occurred (e.g., A19 before A28 in all 49 shared traces, never after); in the later window A28/A29 come first (A28 before A19 in 16 in 100 traces versus A19 before A28 in 1 in 100). [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008]
- A28 and A29 themselves barely moved (mean position about 0.38→0.36 and 0.60→0.58) and still occur in every trace. [POS006, POS007]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

Screening tested 129 control-flow units and 28 items qualified, where an unchanged process would be expected to produce about 0.64; a count many times larger cannot be explained by chance as a whole. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005]

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, the block of alternative activities A19, A20, A25, A26 and A27 is executed after A29/A30 rather than before A28: the block sits between A29 and A34 instead of between A47 and A28, and A47 now connects directly to A28. This is shown directly by relational evidence (the order between each block member and A28/A29 flips from always block-first to almost always anchor-first), by successor changes (the block's transitions moved from A28 to A30/A34, while A29 and A30 gained the block as successors and A47 now leads to A28), by the block's later positions while A28 and A29 stay put, and by step distances consistent with one block activity being inserted between A29 and A30 or between A30 and A34. The block's participation is roughly stable across windows, so this reads as a relocation of existing activities rather than their addition or removal. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG005]

Limitations: the picture is aggregated over 200 traces per window, so it cannot show whether each later case inserts exactly one block activity, nor whether the insertion point (directly after A29 versus after A30) is fixed per case; positions are event positions, not clock times, though the hypothesis rests on ordering evidence rather than position alone. A competing explanation that cannot be fully excluded is a shift in the mix of coexisting variants rather than a single relocated block, but the near-disappearance of the old placement (only about 0–4 in 100 of the block's transitions still lead to A28, and A19 before A28 survives in about 1 in 100 traces) argues against a mere mixture shift. [DIR001, DIR003, REL001, REL005] One flagged relation, A47→A26, rests on only 2 later observations and was not used. [LAG004]

Other differences: a few rare new transitions (about 0.5–1 in 100 of the outgoing transitions of A29 and A30) to activities such as A02, A10 and A28 appear only in the later window. [DIR006, DIR007]

Let me analyse this evidence carefully.

We have 200 traces before, 200 after. Screening: 129 units tested, 28 items qualified, 0.64 expected without change (control_flow family only). So 28 items vs 0.64 expected — that's many times larger, cannot be explained by chance. So we move past the "insufficient evidence" screening gate.

Now let's understand the evidence items.

DIR items (control flow direction, outgoing transitions of source activity):

- DIR001: A19. Before: outgoing transitions all to A28 (1.0). After: A30 0.559, A34 0.382, A04 0.029, A05 0.029. So A19 previously always followed by A28; now mostly A30/A34. Support before 49 traces, after 34 traces.
- DIR002: A20. Before: all to A28. After: A34 0.5, A30 0.5. Support 39/44.
- DIR003: A25. Before: A28 0.972, A49 0.028. After: A34 0.574, A30 0.383, A28 0.043. Support 36/47.
- DIR004: A26. Before: A28 0.972, A40 0.028. After: A34 0.512, A30 0.366, A28 0.024, plus small others. Support 36/41.
- DIR005: A27. Before: A28 0.976, A10 0.024. After: A30 0.548, A34 0.405, small others. Support 42/42.
- DIR006: A29. Before: A30 0.985 (plus tiny others). After: A30 0.5, plus many small components (A19 0.094, A27 0.104, A20 0.109, A25 0.084, A26 0.074...). Support 200/202. So A29 previously almost always followed by A30; now A30 half the time, and various other activities follow.
- DIR007: A30. Before: A34 0.975. After: A34 0.49, plus A25 0.13, A20 0.11, A26 0.105, A27 0.09, A19 0.065. Support 202/200. So A30 previously almost always followed by A34; now A34 half, and various others.
- DIR008: A47. Before: spread over many (A19 0.212, A27 0.187, A20 0.172, A25 0.167, A26 0.163...). After: A28 0.910. Support 203/201. So A47 previously followed by a spread of activities; now almost always A28.

POS items (position within trace, normalized):

- POS001: A19. Before: support 0.245 (24.5% of traces), mean position 0.349. After: support 0.17, mean 0.577. So A19 appears in fewer traces and later.
- POS002: A20. Before: support 0.195, mean 0.342. After: support 0.22, mean 0.626. Later position.
- POS003: A25. Before: support 0.18, mean 0.366. After: support 0.235, mean 0.619.
- POS004: A26. Before: support 0.18, mean 0.352. After: support 0.20, mean 0.612.
- POS005: A27. Before: support 0.21, mean 0.345. After: support 0.21, mean 0.601.
- POS006: A28. Support 1.0 both windows; mean 0.376 → 0.358. Small shift earlier.
- POS007: A29. Support 1.0 both; mean 0.599 → 0.579. Small shift earlier.

REL items (relations between pairs):

- REL001: A19–A28. Before: co-occur 0.245, A19 before A28 0.245 (always A19 then A28). After: co-occurrence 0.17, A28 before A19 0.16, A19 before A28 0.01. So order reversed: previously A19 → A28; now A28 → A19.
- REL002: A19–A29. Same pattern: before A19 before A29 0.245; after A29 before A19 0.155.
- REL003: A20–A28. Before: A20 before A28 0.195. After: A28 before A20 0.22.
- REL004: A20–A29. Before: A20 before A29 0.195. After: A29 before A20 0.22.
- REL005: A25–A28. Before: A25 before A28 0.165. After: A28 before A25 0.225.
- REL006: A25–A29. Before: A25 before A29 0.175. After: A29 before A25 0.225.
- REL007: A27–A28. Before: A27 before A28 0.21. After: A28 before A27 0.20.
- REL008: A27–A29. Before: A27 before A29 0.21. After: A29 before A27 0.205.

LAG items (distance in steps between ordered pair within 5 steps):

- LAG001: A29→A30. Before: distance 1 in 0.985. After: distance 1 in 0.505, distance 2 in 0.48. So A30 now often two steps after A29 rather than immediately.
- LAG002: A29→A34. Before: distance 2 in 0.97. After: distance 3 in 0.94. So shifted by one step.
- LAG003: A30→A34. Before: distance 1 in 0.985. After: distance 1 in 0.49, distance 2 in 0.50.

- LAG005: A47→A28. Before: distance 2 in 0.903. After: distance 1 in 0.908. So A28 now immediately after A47.

So the picture: In the before window, the sequence around the middle was: A47 → (A19|A20|A25|A26|A27) → A28 ... A29 → A30 → A34.

In the after window: A47 → A28 ... A29 → (A30 or one of A19|A20|A25|A26|A27) → ... A30 → A34 (with an extra step inserted sometimes). The group {A19, A20, A25, A26, A27} moved from before A28 to after A29/A30, i.e., they now sit between A29/A30 and A34. That explains:
- LAG002: A29 → A34 distance went from 2 to 3 (one activity inserted between).
- LAG001/003: A29→A30 and A30→A34 distances sometimes 2 (something inserted between A29 and A30? Wait, A29→A30 distance 2 means one event between them. Hmm, if the group is inserted after A30, then A29→A30 stays 1. But DIR006 shows A29 now followed by A19/A20/A25/A26/A27 directly (about 9-11% each, total ~46%). And DIR007 shows A30 followed by the group (~50% total). So the group is inserted sometimes after A29 (before A30) and sometimes after A30 (before A34). That explains A29→A30 distance 2 in 48% of cases (group member between A29 and A30), and A30→A34 distance 2 in 50% (group member between A30 and A34).

So the structural change: the block of alternative activities {A19, A20, A25, A26, A27} moved from before A28 (right after A47) to the segment between A29 and A34 (after A29 and/or after A30). Meanwhile A47 now leads directly to A28.

This is a relocation of a group of activities — a change in order/placement. The evidence is relational (REL shows order reversal between each group member and A28/A29), directional (DIR shows predecessors changed: group members now follow A29/A30 instead of preceding A28; A47 now leads to A28), positional (group members' mean position moved from ~0.35 to ~0.60), and lag (A47→A28 distance 2→1; A29→A34 distance 2→3).

All items are consistent with one underlying change: the alternative block moved later in the process, and A47 connects directly to A28.

Number of items: 28 vs 0.64 expected — many times larger. So we proceed.

The hypothesis: a group of alternative activities (A19, A20, A25, A26, A27) that was executed between A47 and A28 (before A28) in the earlier window is now executed after A29/A30 (between A29 and A34) in the later window; A47 now leads directly to A28.

This is direct, consistent, and rules out competing explanations like "the group was removed and different activities added" — no, the same activities appear, just later and with different neighbours.
